The first tournament of the series was held in September-October 2024 and attracted 19 participants. The winner was {{Player|Estoty Klyb|flag=ru}}, a professional from Quake Live and Quake Champions.

===Format===
* Double Elimination brackets
* 10 min map with 3 min overtime
* All rounds are {{abbr|BO3|Best of Three}}
* Pick, Pick, Toss, Toss, Toss, Toss, Toss, Toss, Toss, Toss, Play
* Higher seed picks first, then it alternates
* Default map pool of 11 maps
* Ruleset: smackdown / qcon / thunderdome
* Allowed only russian speak players
* A player who lost with {{abbr|WO|Walk Over}} in WB will automatically lose with WO in LB too.

===Prize pool===
$300 (USD) are spread among the players as seen below. Prizes are only handed out to teams that never lost any map on {{abbr|WO|Walk Over}}.
